user.title: LEGO Price Tracker
user.description: Most settings are also available in the LEGO Price Tracker panel under Manage → Settings.

data.spread_hours: Spread cycle: every set once every … hours
data.refresh_times: Fixed times (only for 'At fixed times', e.g. 07:30, 19:30)
data.min_history_days: Minimum days of history before a 'record low' counts
data.use_impersonation: Imitate a Chrome browser (curl_cffi; far fewer blocks)
data.notify_service: Notify service for deals (optional; better: the Notifications tab in the panel)

error.invalid_times: Enter 1 to 6 times as HH:MM, separated by commas

init.title: LEGO Price Tracker
init.description: Most settings are also available in the LEGO Price Tracker panel under Manage → Settings.

data.spread_hours: Spread cycle: every set once every … hours
data.refresh_times: Fixed times (only for 'At fixed times', e.g. 07:30, 19:30)
data.min_history_days: Minimum days of history before a 'record low' counts
data.use_impersonation: Imitate a Chrome browser (curl_cffi; far fewer blocks)
data.notify_service: Notify service for deals (optional; better: the Notifications tab in the panel)

error.invalid_times: Enter 1 to 6 times as HH:MM, separated by commas

options.spread: Spread over the day (every set once per cycle)

add_set.name: Add set
add_set.description: Track a LEGO set (watchlist) or add it to your collection. Shop links and set data are looked up automatically.

remove_set.name: Remove set
remove_set.description: Stop tracking a set and delete its price history.

set_offer.name: Set shop link
set_offer.description: Link a shop product page (URL or ASIN) to a set by hand.

refresh.name: Refresh prices
refresh.description: Fetch shop prices now (all sets, or one set).

import_collection.name: Import collection
import_collection.description: Import or update your collection from CSV text or a CSV file.

report_price.name: Report price
report_price.description: Store a price for a tracked product (by URL, or by set number and shop). Used by the userscript and automations.

send_digest.name: Send digest
send_digest.description: Send the daily deals digest now.

discover_offers.name: Find shop links
discover_offers.description: Search every active shop for missing product links (background job).

enrich_sets.name: Fill in set data
enrich_sets.description: Fill in name, theme, RRP, image… from LEGO.com, Brickset and Rebrickable.

verify_links.name: Verify links
verify_links.description: Judge all shop links again (right product, accessories, price).

confirm_offer.name: Approve link
confirm_offer.description: Mark a shop link as the correct product.

remove_offer.name: Remove link
remove_offer.description: Remove a shop link (and block it from being found again).

cancel_job.name: Cancel job
cancel_job.description: Stop the running background job after the current set.

export_data.name: Export data
export_data.description: Return a full backup as JSON.

import_data.name: Restore backup
import_data.description: Restore a backup made with Export data (validated first).

fix_offer.name: Fix shop link / price
fix_offer.description: Set the correct link and/or a manual price for a set at a shop. Manual values always win over automatic ones.
